sources_of_truth: External owner facts remain authoritative. Platform owns technical orchestration/journal/outbox state only; no second transcript/money/metering/entitlement/knowledge-license owner.
platform_sql_scope: Action journal/effect refs under dated semantics
privacy_policy: Minimal purpose-bound refs/projections. Temporary payload retention and encryption are required design contracts; no storage implementation claimed. Secrets/raw provider response never enter public error.
certainty_policy: Unknown effect/invocation/delivery/usage/admission is not failed/success/zero/allow. Current owner policy and emergency guards override pins.
evidence_boundary: Provided owner decisions and adopted contracts, plus inspected source baseline. No external owner implementation, FOUNDATION/HYBRID gate, provider live or pilot readiness asserted.
